name: The original rule grammar
hypothesis: Trading rules can be bred as a grammar over indicators, and a search over that grammar finds combinations a person would not write by hand.
mechanism: Rule grammar plus a regime router (codex_regime_system). The lineage the later generations branch from.
data: daily and 15m candles across every listed asset of the era, not a survivor set

helped.what: Defining the market as every listed asset of the time
helped.effect: removed the survivorship bias that six hand-picked survivors had been quietly supplying

helped.what: Three levels of trend plus a global one that does not churn
helped.effect: a trend read that changes when the trend changes rather than when the noise does

helped.what: Seeding the search from what the bounce ladder actually measured
helped.effect: the search starts from a measured shape instead of a random point in the grammar

hurt.what: Sizing by name rather than by volatility
hurt.effect: the book bought a 15%-a-day asset the same size as a 5%-a-day one, so the portfolio's risk was set by whichever names happened to be in it

hurt.what: A bear label that selected recoveries, not falls
hurt.effect: every conclusion drawn about bear behaviour before it was fixed described the wrong bars

hurt.what: A loop that could not start, with no test able to see why
hurt.effect: the failure was invisible to the suite, which is the class of bug this laboratory has since spent the most time on

open.what: Whether a bred rule grammar beats a trained model
open.why: the lineage moved to learned models at generation 06 without ever settling this directly

rules: The universe is every asset LISTED AT THE TIME, never the ones that survived to today. Survivorship is the easiest large error to make here and the hardest to see afterwards.
Size by volatility, not by name. Equal notional across unequal assets is a risk decision disguised as a neutral one.
A label is a measurement. Check what the bear label SELECTED before trusting anything conditioned on it.

results.verdict: Frozen. The lineage the later generations branch from; its measured record is the set of biases it removed, not a sealed return.
